text: レッドと　グリーン！
note: This is a nod to the real games: in Japan the first Pokémon games came out in 1996 as Pocket Monsters Red and Green, not Red and Blue as abroad.
claim: The first Pokémon games were released in Japan in 1996 as Pocket Monsters Red and Green.

check.quote: Pocket Monsters Red and Green were the first Pokémon games to be released in Japan, developed by Game Freak and published by Nintendo for the Game Boy. They were released on February 27, 1996 in Japan.
check.note: This is a nod to the real games: in Japan the first Pokémon games came out in 1996 as Pocket Monsters Red and Green, not Red and Blue as abroad.
